purpose: diagnostic only: test exact-ray cropped direct renders as a repair for candidate unknown pixels

roi.selection_basis: fixed development ROI covering every request-mask pixel in both archived episode_004/005 i masks; masks are retained and this ROI is not asserted to generalize beyond these clips

auxiliary_camera.projection: bundled pyrender IntrinsicsCamera with exact source fx/fy and principal point shifted by crop origin

roi.repair_rule: copy exact auxiliary-camera radiance only into candidate request pixels inside this crop; do not dilate, filter, or alter sensor thresholds
roi.outside_crop_rule: charge a full-frame direct render fallback for any request pixels outside the crop

evaluation.query_times: only existing saved physical-state rows; no new state interpolation beyond the candidate's existing geometric method

full-frame crop vs auxiliary ROI link segmentation

separate requested-interval and supported-interval event agreement
